text:
Alex Chen: FYI — kicking off a cross-team sync to define regional/zone dashboards. Need runtime + infra inputs. Primary metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency by region/zone, failover impact (latency spike + success-rate changes), traffic-split per-region. Anyone able to align quickly? @Maya R. @Kevin Patel
Maya R.: I can own runtime telemetry. Plan: emit per-request tags: region, availability_zone, route, backend_model, fallback_reason. Concern: tag cardinality — keep `route` low-cardinality (service-level route, not full path).
Kevin Patel: Infra will export pool/GPU metrics + network metrics per-zone. For failover analysis we need the router to attach `x-chosen-region` and `x-original-region` headers so we can correlate. Also propose a synthetic gauge `router.traffic_split` counting requests routed per-region and route.
Alex Chen: Router team can add `x-chosen-region` and `x-original-region` headers. Runtime please add those fields into traces/metrics. We want both per-minute and rolling-window (1m/5m) aggregations.
Sophia Li: Console/UX notes: small metric tiles for p50/p95/p99 (1m / 5m / 1h), a zone heatmap, and an event timeline for rollouts/failovers (show correlated spikes). Can the rollout service emit events (webhooks) when a rollout changes traffic?
Infra Bot: Checklist created:
- router: add headers `x-chosen-region`, `x-original-region`
- runtime: emit latency histograms with tags region, az, route, backend_model, fallback_reason
- infra: export `pool_utilization` and `network_egress` per-zone
- rollout svc: webhook endpoint `/hooks/dashboard-events` (include metadata: rollout_id, from_region, to_region, percent)
- metrics: create DD tags `region`, `availability_zone`, `route`, `backend_model`, `fallback_reason`
Kevin Patel: On histogram buckets — runtime suggests log-linear buckets up to 5s with finer granularity below 200ms (e.g., 0-5ms,5-10,10-20,20-50,50-100,100-200,200-500,500-1k,1k-2k,2k-5k). Good?
Maya R.: That sounds good. Also enumerating `fallback_reason` values: `capacity`, `timeout`, `degraded_model`, `manual_override`. Will standardize in schema.
Alex Chen: Draft viz queries (Datadog-like examples):
```
# p95 by region over last 5m
avg:last_5m:percentile(95, latency{*}) by {region}
# traffic split per region
sum:router.requests{*}.as_count() by {region,route}
```
Also we should expose `chosen_region` vs `original_region` delta distribution.
Ops Oncall: I'll wire up alerts: condition => p99 > 2s sustained for 5m AND error_rate_increase > 3% => page. Question: should alerts be per-tenant by default or global?
Sophia Li: Both. Default dashboard is global, with a tenant selector to drill into per-tenant metrics and alerts scoped to tenant when enabled. Also want a post-failover delta panel: compare last 15m vs previous 1h.
Alex Chen: Action items: Maya to add tags + histogram buckets (ETA: EOD Thu), Kevin to add pool exports + router headers (ETA: EOD Fri), Sophia to prototype dashboard layout (ETA: next Tue). I'll file tickets and link here. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Maya R.: Ack, will post schema PR once instrumented.
Kevin Patel: Ack — infra will add exporter and router change in the same rollout to make correlation easier.
Sophia Li: I'll start a Figma with tiles and heatmap mock, will share link here when ready.
Alex Chen: Great — follow-ups: 1) define exact tag names and enum values in a tiny spec, 2) rollout svc webhook contract, 3) sample viz queries for the Console team. I'll create the trio of tickets now and ping owners.
Infra Bot: Ticket skeletons generated and linked in thread: TICKET-PLAT-4123, TICKET-INFRA-2190, TICKET-DEVEX-778.
Alex Chen: Perfect, closing sync for now. If anything urgent pop in this thread or ping me.
Sophia Li: thanks all :)
